name: ok-minimal-columns
note: the smallest valid list-spec — required columns map with one text column.

name: ok-shorthand-and-boolean-format
note: CellFormat polymorphism — a bare type string and a boolean both validate.

name: ok-sortable-sort-pagination-actions-empty-design
note: The sort, pagination, actions, empty and design read-structure slots validate together.

name: ok-compose-ref-patch-columns
note: $ref/$patch compose entry on the columns map (the SAME engine as form-spec). files resolve the base for the four-language engine; ajv ignores files and reads only spec.

name: ok-search-form-ref
note: search is input → a form-spec reference ($ref base + $patch overlay). files resolve the base form for the engine; ajv ignores files and reads only spec.

name: red-missing-columns
note: A list specification without required columns is rejected. This shape check is defined only by the meta-schema, so the four-language composition and forbidden-key engine accepts it.

name: red-forbidden-column-key
note: A forbidden condition meta-key used as a column key is rejected. The four-language engine also rejects the key as a load failure.

name: red-x-prefixed-column-key
note: An x-prefixed comment-residue key used as a column key is rejected. The four-language engine also rejects every remaining x{key}.

name: red-unknown-column-key
note: A column with an unregistered key is rejected by additionalProperties:false. The four-language engine also rejects show_if as a forbidden meta-key load failure.

name: red-forbidden-key-in-format-options
note: A forbidden meta-key inside the open CellFormat options object is rejected. The four-language engine scans the format object and rejects 'if' as a load failure.

name: red-bad-sort-dir
note: sort.dir accepts only asc or desc. This enum check is defined only by the meta-schema, so the four-language engine accepts the value.

name: red-unknown-sort-key
note: Sort accepts only field and dir, so an extra key is rejected. This object-shape check is defined only by the meta-schema; the four-language engine accepts nulls because it is not a forbidden meta-key.

name: red-unknown-pagination-key
note: Pagination accepts only per_page and mode, so an extra key is rejected. This object-shape check is defined only by the meta-schema; the four-language engine accepts limit because it is not a forbidden meta-key.

name: red-bad-pagination-mode
note: pagination.mode accepts only pages, offset, cursor or none. This enum check is defined only by the meta-schema, so the four-language engine accepts the value.

name: red-unknown-list-top-key
note: A list rejects an unregistered top-level key through additionalProperties:false. This object-shape check is defined only by the meta-schema; the four-language engine accepts limit because it is not a forbidden meta-key.

name: red-unknown-action-key
note: A ListAction object rejects an unregistered action key. This object-shape check is defined only by the meta-schema; the four-language engine accepts onclick because it is not a forbidden meta-key.

name: red-malformed-format-value
note: CellFormat accepts a boolean, string or object, so anyOf rejects an array. This type check is defined only by the meta-schema; the four-language engine accepts the array because it contains no forbidden key.
